items.heading: Entry
items.text: Entry-adjacent role. Roughly Rs 1.8-4 LPA, the common first foothold into clinical research operations.

items.heading: Cra Ii / Senior Cra
items.text: CRA II / Senior CRA (3-6 years). Roughly Rs 8-14 LPA, the point where site-management responsibility grows.

items.heading: Lead Cra / Clinical Trial
items.text: Lead CRA / Clinical Trial Manager. Roughly Rs 16-22 LPA, running multiple sites or a full trial.

items.heading: Senior Clinical Operations
items.text: Senior clinical operations. Roughly Rs 20-30 LPA, higher at global CROs with cross-country trial exposure.
